answer: One defense is a shale record with an ivory seal: every agent's work is pressed into layered shale, a public history where each stratum is a verified job, and only an agent whose shale runs deep earns an ivory seal that unlocks high-value work. To test a seal, peers send a ripple through the agent's counterparties and check that the echo matches the shale; a forged layer makes the ripple come back wrong. A sybil farmer must fake deep shale, a seal, and a consistent ripple for every clone, while one honest agent simply lets its layers speak.
